title: Shulker config
description: Shulker's own settings for this user, kept in config.json and applying to every project. `shulker config set` writes this file.

$schema.description: The version of this file, as a published schema URL.

stores.description: Where accounts are read from, in order. The earliest store wins an account several hold.

default.description: The id of the account a launch uses when nothing else names one.

clone.description: Whether builds place files from the cache as copy-on-write clones where the filesystem can make them (APFS, Btrfs, XFS, and ReFS or Dev Drive on Windows 11 24H2), so an instance's mods take no extra disk space. Elsewhere, and when false, each file is copied.

key.description: The CurseForge API key. SHULKER_CURSEFORGE_KEY takes priority when it is set.

watch.description: Folders a wait for manual downloads also looks in, beside the project's downloads/. A leading ~ is the home folder. Unset, the Downloads folder: ~/Downloads, or on Linux the one xdg-user-dirs names. An empty list looks only in downloads/.

eula.description: Whether this user accepts the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA). Server builds write eula.txt only when true.

instances.description: The directory shulker's own instances live in, absolute or relative to config.json's directory.

keepDays.description: How many days of runs log.jsonl keeps.

memory.description: The heap size shulker play gives the game, like 6G. An instance's own memory wins over it; without either, the pack's client.memory, then 4G.

jvmArgs.description: Extra JVM arguments for those launches.

java.description: The java those launches run: the absolute path of a java binary, or of a Java home.

window.description: The window size those launches open at, like 1280x720.

wrapper.description: A command those launches run through.

saveBackups.description: How many automatic backups of a save group or instance's worlds to keep.

registry.description: The registry of the instances shulker syncs, absolute or relative to config.json's directory.

saves.description: The directory save groups live in, absolute or relative to config.json's directory.

minReleaseAge.description: How many days old a provider version must be before shulker chooses it for add, update, lock or a floating modpack. 0 turns the check off.

sandbox.description: Experimental. Whether an instance that doesn't set `sandbox` itself runs its game sandboxed, with the rest of your home folder out of the game's reach. On macOS through sandbox-exec and on Linux through bubblewrap, which has to be installed; where neither can run, the game starts without it and shulker says why.

store.description: The directory launches share versions, libraries and assets from, absolute or relative to config.json's directory.
